metadata.method_name: Matched-dose site sweep of isotropic random displacements (C1-site), alpha-8 boundary with novelty audit (C3c), top-five plan-site push (C3d)

model.quant: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)
model.stop: end of turn or closing code fence

metadata.conventions: block l = hidden_states[l+1]; S = [first 'Task:' token, last user token); R = P-1; COND = condition sentence; CRN slot = (task, template, k); direction u(t,w,k) shared by all arms

hardware.precision_rule: VRAM >= 19.5 GiB -> bf16; Ada/Hopper < 19.5 GiB -> exp17 FP8 W8A8; Ampere < 19.5 GiB -> FP8 weight-only
hardware.quant: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)

c3d.status: descriptive (K=7: 2 gated survivors -> exact permutation p floor 0.5; extended labeller flagged)

overlap_check.null: pooled (template-stratified where both sides carry templates) resampling of the two compositions at their own sizes, 2,000 draws; REPRODUCED if JS <= null q95

deviations.what: FP8 W8A8 (exp17 engine) instead of the bf16 the plan expected on an RTX A4500
deviations.why: the machine has a 16 GB RTX 2000 Ada (compute 8.9); the frozen precision rule (commit #0) maps Ada < 19.5 GiB to the exp17 FP8 W8A8 path; every arm uses it
deviations.cost: C1-site statements are 'in FP8 W8A8'; the engine check compares like with like (FP8 vs FP8) and reproduced the screen byte for byte

deviations.what: fixed batch B = 20 rows for every task and max_new 1024 for every task (plan: B 16/12 and 1,536 for T1/T2 on a 20 GiB card)
deviations.why: exp17's U1b-verified shape on this GPU; keeps the screen's uniforms and shape for the engine check; U6 peak 13.2 GiB
deviations.cost: rows longer than 1,024 tokens are truncated: 0 of 466 twin rows, 4 of 2,760 rows at alpha <= 2, 47 of 1,150 at alpha 4, 0 at alpha 8 (finish_reason per cell in results/cells.json)

deviations.what: COND includes the token where the tokenizer merges the sentence's final '.' with the '\n\n' separator
deviations.why: the separator cannot be excluded without also excluding the period
deviations.cost: none for the S2 target (the ban-twin displacement there is measured, not assumed)

deviations.what: U4 shadow fidelity vs an independent batch-1 teacher-forced forward fails the 1e-2 threshold
deviations.why: see results/u4_diagnostic.json: FP8 decode-path states differ from a teacher-forced prefill of the same tokens even with no edit; the shadow is the exact clean reference WITHIN the decode path (U2: S3 at alpha 0 reproduces the twin byte for byte; U3: along-u displacement vs the shadow = target within 0.01%)
deviations.cost: S3's reference state is 'clean decode-path state', not 'teacher-forced state'; the contrast with the hooked row is exact

deviations.what: first-token KL is degenerate (the first generated token is always the code fence, p ~ 1 in every arm)
deviations.why: the prompt asks for one ```python block
deviations.cost: the transmission analysis rests on the realised displacement at R (block 35); the KL model is reported as uninformative; S3 keeps its step-wise KL (steps 1-32)

deviations.what: commit #1 (before the first decisive sample) holds the predictions, every decision rule and threshold, and the hull + C1 decision code (hull.py); analysis.py, outputs.py, figures.py, audit.py, label_k7.py and audit/rederive.py were written while sampling ran and committed in #2 before being run on the full data
deviations.why: time budget; the GPU would otherwise have idled
deviations.cost: rules for everything outside hull.py are fixed by predictions.json text, not by code hashes

deviations.what: protocol v4's hash(task, arm, slot) is read with arm = the PN family ('PN4'), so one direction per slot is shared by every site, dose and boundary arm

the 'norm-matched random direction' control of the TOP5 push is a distribution of fresh per-slot directions at the same per-position norm (S0 rows, k 0-9), not one draw; u_top5 is per block while PN shares one u across blocks
novelty-audit judges are exp18's recorded ids (google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, openai/gpt-4.1-mini); tie-break deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 (exp9's tie-break model)
deviations.why: the plan names 'exp18's ids'; its parenthetical 'gemini-2.5-flash' differs from what exp18 actually used

deviations.what: exp13's FP8 units differ from this artifact's by median ratio 1.12-1.32 (exp17's: 0.99-1.00)
deviations.cost: logged as unit drift; exp17 (same prompts) agrees to 0.2%

deviations.what: exp13 rand1-3 rows are compared with exp13's hf_twin (same HF engine) in the screen file
labelling judge caches started empty (exp17's caches were not copied)
deviations.cost: a few cents of extra judge spend

deviations.what: 'invalid' = no code block, syntax error or no solve() for EVERY task (the bench labeller's rule; the exp8 path labeller otherwise labels non-programs such as '[your_answer]')
deviations.why: the plan defines 'invalid' as its own column; at alpha 8 the model often writes placeholders. Introduced AFTER commit #2, after inspecting alpha-8 outputs, and applied to every arm; committed in #3 with the final analysis code (units summary, argmax robustness to a missing site, an explicit name for the failure-mode case the frozen rule leaves uncovered)
deviations.cost: attempt-level shares only; correct-only results (Hill, H5, C1-site, C3d) are unaffected because such programs never pass

deviations.what: exp9 K=7 labeller judge cap USD 0.10 (exp9 default 0.70)
deviations.why: share of the plan's labelling-judge budget
deviations.cost: none: K=7 judge spend was USD 0.066 and no row fell back (labeller_source: agree 763, judge 181, no_code 22)

deviations.what: the stage-100 projection used by the budget gate (0.37 h; results/timing_projection.json) was computed on the first five batches, which were fast T05 batches
deviations.why: alpha-4 S2/S3/S4 and S1E batches later ran to the full 1,024 tokens (~67 s each); the realised decisive sampling took 1.69 h wall time (1.74 GPU-hours of batch time including tests, engine check and smoke), still inside the plan's 2.0 h gate, so no cell was dropped
deviations.cost: none; the gate's projection rule should use per-arm-type timings (logged for the next run)

deviations.what: the STEP 11.10 overlap check's template-resampling null was added after commit #3 (the first version reported JS without a null)
deviations.why: the plan specifies the null; exp19's Step-1 rows turned out to exist
deviations.cost: none: the comparison is descriptive and committed in #4
